messages:
Priya Rao: Friday afterwork idea — Spritz + ping-pong + potluck on the terrace? Start 6:30, winds down by 9. Casual, BYO drink or spritz mix. Thoughts?
Tom: Love it. I can bring a portable ping-pong net and paddles.
Ivy: In! Ill bring a big bowl of caprese skewers (GF).
Jordan: Maybe bring a small cooler? I can stash ice and soft drinks.
Nina: Quick q: kids allowed? Thinking of bringing partner + one kid.
Priya Rao: Kids welcome as long as someone watches them — terrace has benches but not gates.
Tom: RSVP format suggestion to keep it simple: "Yes / Maybe / No" + headcount + food offer.
Ivy: Yes / 1 / caprese skewers (GF).
Jordan: Yes / 2 / ice + seltzer.
Nina: Maybe / 2 adults + 1 kid / mini cupcakes.
ops-bot: Note: terrace use after 6pm requires floor-team signoff. Tag @facilities to confirm.
Priya Rao: Tagged @facilities — can someone cover quick setup/cleanup rota? 15m setup, 20m cleanup?
Tom: I can handle setup (nets + tables) and cleanup second shift.
Ivy: Ill handle napkins/plates (compostable).
Jordan: Cleanup first shift. Also can bring a bluetooth speaker for music.
Priya Rao: Calendar invite pending  will set location to "Terrace (alt: Lobby Lounge)" and add note re: kids.
calendar-bot: Event created  "Spritz, Pong & Potluck"  Fri 2024-12-06 18:30  Location: Terrace (alt: Lobby Lounge). RSVP in thread.
Priya Rao: Small poll tomorrow AM: terrace vs lobby lounge (weather fallback).
Tom: :thumbsup: Also FYI, paddle rules: no beer bottles as paddles.
Nina: :joy: noted. Thanks all!
Jordan: Excited  see you Friday.
Priya Rao: Final heads-up: bring one portable light if you have it, terrace gets dim after sunset.
